uiTextStyleReview.result: No hardcoded user-facing copy in the Task58 approval/question components; all 31 literal t() keys and 9 dynamic keys resolve in en.ts and all dictionaries pass parity.
nonblockingNotes: The public approval contract intentionally exposes the opaque policy pattern 'native-input'; the exact command is shown in the parameter preview while the private policy target stays in the Agent Service.
Tab focus leaves the dock after the footer actions; the restored baseline has no focus trap.

securityPass.result: No blocking findings. UI renders sanitized ApprovalRequest details and option labels as text, parses omp.ask schema with zod, submits version/epoch/workerGeneration read from the authoritative pending record, keeps authorization in the Host authorizer, and never logs credentials or raw private targets.
nonblockingNotes: Escape neither dismisses nor cancels a pending request; this matches the pre-M1 baseline and no accidental submission was observed.

One CAS run left the resolved question dock visible until the next reload; two subsequent reruns cleared it within 600 ms via the recovery snapshot. Recorded as an intermittent observation, not reproduced.

keyboardFocusEscape.tabSequence: Radiogroup controls -> Other -> Dismiss -> Next -> focus leaves the dock to app chrome (no focus trap, baseline parity).

keyboardFocusEscape.accessibility: Dialog and radiogroup expose role/aria-label; radios expose aria-checked; the freeform answer textarea is focused when its step mounts.

imeComposition.method: CDP Input.imeSetComposition('にほんご') into the focused textarea; Enter via Input.dispatchKeyEvent; a capture listener recorded {key:'Enter', isComposing:true, keyCode:13}. This simulates an IME composition; no system IME was used.
imeComposition.result: During composition the pending count stayed 1 and the value stayed 'にほんご'; Enter did not submit. After committing via Input.insertText('にほんご入力'), Enter submitted and the ask result carried customInput 'にほんご入力'.

casStaleRejection.method: The UI reply POST was paused with CDP Fetch interception after the UI read version 1; a competing direct reply with the same version was resolved first (200); the paused UI reply was then released.
casStaleRejection.result: UI reply rejected with 409 QUESTION_CONFLICT; visible toast 'Failed to send response / Try again.'; the dock was cleared by recovery (dialog null within 600 ms in the reproducible rerun). A subsequent old-version reply also returned 409. Terminal tool result contains only the accepted 'Alpha' selection, never the rejected 'Beta'.
casStaleRejection.limitation: One earlier CAS run kept the stale dock visible until reload; not reproduced in two reruns.

restartExpiry.method: Pending bash approval, then the isolated Host was stopped and restarted on the same data dir.
restartExpiry.result: After restart snapshot 200 had 0 pending approvals/questions; the old reply returned 410 APPROVAL_EXPIRED ('Request belongs to an expired worker generation'); the deny marker remained absent, so the rejected action did not execute; final snapshot 0 pending.
